aliases.reason: The faithfully flat and flat ring-map definitions both equip S with precisely the restriction-of-scalars R-module structure induced by φ:R→S, with r·s=φ(r)s. Faithful flatness and flatness are different parent properties, not equivalent to the module action itself.

The unital and nonunital Boolean-ring formulations both require universal elementwise idempotence x²=x. The two raw candidate contexts literally match on the underlying idempotent predicate. Having a unit remains a separate parent ring convention, not conferred by idempotence.

The Nagata-ring source uses the quotient R/p by a prime ideal p. This is the general commutative unital quotient-ring operation R/I specialized to I=p; primality and Japanese/Nagata conditions remain specific to the source.

The geometrically reduced base-change formulation and geometrically integral/perfect-closure formulations invoke identical scalar extension of commutative unital k-algebras along K/k, forming A⊗_kK as a K-algebra with induced multiplication. Reducedness, integrality and choice of K are distinct parent requirements.
